tree: Taipei, June 4, 2026. French computer-use AI startup H Company has joined the NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition, an international initiative bringing together leading open-source artificial intelligence players. The announcement was made at NVIDIA's global GTC conference, held in Taipei from June 1 to 4.

Launched by NVIDIA on March 16, 2026, the coalition gathers top research laboratories and technology companies to advance open, frontier-level foundation models. Its goal is to combine expertise, computing power, and data resources to foster more powerful, collaborative, and accessible AI systems. By joining the coalition, H Company further strengthens its position as one of Europe's most promising computer-use AI companies, a new generation of artificial intelligence capable of executing complex tasks and autonomously interacting with digital environments.

tree: We are delighted to join the NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition. It is essential for French and European companies to actively participate in the international ecosystems where the future of artificial intelligence is being built. This collaboration with the other coalition members will enable us to accelerate our work on open models and contribute to a more innovative, efficient, and accessible AI ecosystem.
Gautier Cloix, CEO of H Company

Founded in Paris in 2023, H Company is at the forefront of computer-use, an AI capable not only of generating text, but of executing tasks directly within digital interfaces. With Holo3, its model designed to operate digital environments, and HoloTab, its Chrome extension conceived as a simple entry point into these new use cases, H aims to make this new generation of AI concrete, accessible, and immediately actionable. The company is led by Gautier Cloix, former CEO of Palantir France, since June 2025 to support a new phase of structuring and commercial deployment around agentic AI.
